title: 3/31: the first `bts run` automation could re-pick over the day's manually posted pick (lock keyed only on game start); days 1-3 pick files were created retroactively that night
missing_evidence: whether any automated `bts run` executed on 2026-03-31 between 18:49 ET (8fc68cb) and 22:08 ET (1c2efaa): the install time of the Mac crontab from dd3b954 (19:30 run 'always posts') and data/picks/automation.log on that host; neither is in the repo
the bot account's public Bluesky post history for 2026-03-31 (a second pick post would show a firing); outside the repo
tier_reason: if a scheduled run fired inside the 3-hour window it could post a second public pick and leave a local record that differs from the posted pick (delivery/state impact, A); no firing is evidenced

contract.text: Once a day's pick has been posted, later automated runs keep it: no re-pick and no second post; the posted pick is the day's record.
contract.source: 1c2efaa ('lock picks that were already posted to Bluesky'; body: 'Prevents cron from overwriting a pick that was already posted')

mechanism.text: cli.run locked the current pick only when its game had started (status != 'P'): a posted pick whose game had not started fell through to re-selection, and a different top batter overwrote the day's pick file (the posted flag carried over, so no second post, but the local record no longer matched the posted pick); a day with no pick file at all (days 1-3 were posted before pick persistence existed) had nothing to lock, so a run could pick and post anew

mitigated.action: retroactive pick files for days 1-3 created (outside git; data/picks is gitignored) so later runs see those days as picked

watchdog.trigger: for a date, more than one pick delivery receipt (post/DM) exists, or the local pick file's selection differs from the delivered selection
watchdog.recovery_assertion: exactly one delivered selection per date and the graded pick equals it

evidence.what: the posted-pick lock 'prevents cron from overwriting a pick that was already posted'; retroactive pick files were created for days 1-3
`bts run` and a Mac crontab (11:00, 16:00, 19:30 'always posts', 01:00 check-results) first existed on the evening of 3/31
